title: Joint convergence in Wiener chaos via transport hierarchy and Malliavin covariances
summary: We study the joint convergence in distribution of a sequence $X_N = I_p(f_N)$ of multiple Wiener--Itô integrals of order $p\geq 2$ that converges to a Gaussian limit $Z\sim N(0,σ^2)$, together with another sequence $Y_N = I_q(g_N)$ converging in law. The central finding is that the joint convergence of $(X_N, Y_N)$ is completely governed by the asymptotic behavior of the iterated Malliavin covariances $Y_{r+1,N} = \langle DX_N, DY_{r,N}\rangle_H$, $r\geq 0$: joint convergence holds as soon as these covariances converge jointly with $Y_N$, and the structure of the limiting distribution is…
